reply.answer: Warning signs of a SIM‑swap scam include: 1) receiving a call or message from someone claiming to be a mobile network staff offering a free upgrade (e.g., 3G to 4G) or extra benefits and asking for your personal or identity details; 2) noticing that your phone suddenly loses mobile network connectivity for an unusually long time in a normal environment.

reply.answer: Be careful when scanning QR codes with any payment app. Only scan codes that you know are safe.
